# Data Import & Plot UX Requirements Checklist: CSV Plot Explorer

**Purpose**: Validate that data-import/error and plot-interaction requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before task generation
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: data import & errors; plot interaction UX. Depth: standard. Audience: PR reviewer.

## Import — Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the header-detection rule defined for a headerless file whose first column is a date/time (so the first row is not "all numbers")? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases "No header row"]
- [x] CHK002 - Are blank lines (in the middle and at the end of the file) and line-ending variants (CRLF, LF) addressed, so a trailing newline is not a field-count error? [Gap]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the full set of missing-value tokens specified, including case variants and common spreadsheet values such as `#N/A`, `null`, and `-`? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases "Missing values"]
- [x] CHK004 - Are accepted numeric formats specified (scientific notation, leading `+`, surrounding whitespace, thousands separators)? [Gap]
- [x] CHK005 - Is behavior defined for files too large to fit in memory, and for files that are locked or unreadable? [Gap; contracts define `OUT_OF_MEMORY`, `FILE_UNREADABLE` but the spec does not]
- [x] CHK006 - Is behavior specified when a load is requested while another load is in progress (GUI and API concurrently), and can a long load be cancelled? [Gap; contract `LOAD_IN_PROGRESS` not in spec]
- [x] CHK007 - Is delimiter-detection fallback defined for single-column files and ambiguous samples? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases "Delimiters"]

## Import — Requirement Clarity & Consistency

- [x] CHK008 - Is the column-type rule consistent between the spec ("first non-empty value") and the data model ("first non-empty, non-missing-token value") for a column that starts with `NA`? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases "Column types"]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the field-count reference defined for headerless files (first record rather than "the header")? [Clarity, Spec §US2-AS2]
- [x] CHK010 - Are date/time rules specified for mixed date-only and date-time values, mixed offset and no-offset values in one column, and fractional-second precision? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases "Date/time columns"]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the row number for a record containing quoted line breaks defined in the spec (the data model says "first line")? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases "Row numbering"]
- [x] CHK012 - Is truncation of long offending values (plan: 64 characters) reflected in the spec's "original value" requirement? [Conflict, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK013 - Is "empty file" defined for whitespace-only or BOM-only files? [Clarity, Spec §US2-AS3]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the set of error and warning kinds (FR-012) enumerated or referenced from the spec so completeness can be reviewed? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012]

## Import — Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Is the "suggested next step" content defined per error kind so it can be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK016 - Is warning presentation specified for very large bad-cell counts (paging, summary first)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011a]

## Plot UX — Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK017 - Is the initial view after plotting defined (fit to data, with how much padding)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK018 - Is it specified whether the current zoom is kept or reset when Y columns are added/removed, the style is toggled, or the window is resized? [Gap, Spec §US1-AS3, §US1-AS7]
- [x] CHK019 - Are empty states defined: no file loaded, file loaded but nothing plotted, all series hidden? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the loading-state UI specified (indicator, and whether the current plot stays interactive during a load)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK021 - Are requirements defined for how the GUI announces API-triggered loads, plots, and errors (notification style, window focus)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 - Is it specified where the warnings list appears and how it is dismissed or reopened? [Gap, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK023 - Is it specified where users see the local API address or an API startup failure? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Plot UX — Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK024 - Is the box-zoom gesture specified (modifier key or button) rather than only "distinct from panning"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009a]
- [x] CHK025 - Is "near a plotted point" quantified (pixel radius) with a rule for choosing between overlapping series? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009b]
- [x] CHK026 - Are the reset-view trigger(s) specified (button, double-click, keyboard)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK027 - Are zoom step per wheel notch and minimum/maximum zoom limits defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK028 - Are numeric-axis tick and label rules defined (tick density, scientific notation for very large/small values)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK029 - Are time-axis label rules specified beyond examples (sub-second through multi-year spans)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK030 - Is series color assignment defined (stable per column when others are added/removed, behavior beyond the palette size)? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK031 - Is legend behavior defined for many series and long column names? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK032 - Is hover behavior defined over hidden series and at missing-value gaps? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009b, §FR-009c]

## Plot UX — Non-Functional (Accessibility & Appearance)

- [x] CHK033 - Are keyboard alternatives specified for opening files, choosing columns, and pan/zoom/reset? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK034 - Are series colors required to be distinguishable for common color-vision deficiencies? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK035 - Is "distinct and legible in both light and dark appearance" measurable (e.g., minimum contrast against the plot background)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010a]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK036 - Is the measurement method for SC-005 (first-time user under 1 minute) and SC-006 (fix on first attempt) defined (who, how many, what counts as success)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §SC-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
